identity.description: Three-layer business identity (NGA §7.2). Retries/recovery reuse operation_id; a new evaluation under new versions is a new evaluation_revision linked to the same business_request_id.

execution_generation.description: e — current execution ownership generation. Minted once per claim (hermes generation-stamp precedent: first opener wins). Renewal/takeover decisions belong to W04; Go stores the result. 0 = original claim; increments on verified takeover.

logical_execution.description: o = (T, g, node_path, iteration_path) — the logical node execution identity (邢 GC#2 2026-11-13 formalization, adopted verbatim). T = the accepted task (business_request_id + graph_version); g = the adopted graph version/sha; node_path/iteration_path locate the node within the graph including loop/branch ordinals. operation_id remains the attempt (a) identity — o is the durable logical key that survives retries. All four fields required (atomic tuple — partial or empty logical_execution is invalid; M-1 fix): old events carry only operation_id (a-granularity); new events SHOULD carry logical_execution for graph-aware consumers (W04). See batch-0 scope (130/132号).

graph_version.description: g — the adopted graph version/sha. Frozen at adoption by W04; Go stores but does not decide.

iteration_path.description: Loop/branch ordinal path (e.g. 'iter:2' or 'loop:1/branch:B/iter:2'). Composes with node_path to form the full execution position.

node_path.description: Path of the node within the graph (e.g. 'n3' or 'workflow/collection/n3' for nested). Nested/loop use parent path + ordinals.

task_id.description: T — the accepted task identifier. In v0.1.0+1.0.0 this maps to business_request_id at the single-node level; graph-aware producers supply their own task identifier.
